requirements:
  - id: S-1
    text: "The block shall accept a signed 16-bit audio sample that is held between sample writes."
    proof: [simulation]
    modules: []
  - id: S-2
    text: "The block shall provide an unsigned Q15 gain register that resets to 2068; a gain write above 8192 shall store 8192, and any other gain write shall store the written value."
    proof: [simulation]
    modules: []
  - id: S-3
    text: "The signed 16-bit sample_out shall be combinationally computed as floor(sample * gain / 32768)."
    proof: [simulation, formal]
    modules: []
  - id: S-4
    text: "When CPU_RESETN is asserted, the sample shall be cleared to zero and the gain register shall be set to 2068."
    proof: [simulation]
    modules: []
  - id: S-5
    text: "The UART shell shall run at 115200 baud and shall support writing the sample, writing the gain, and reading sample_out."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: []
  - id: S-6
    text: "The PWM shall use a free-running 10-bit counter clocked by CLK100MHZ, producing a 1024-clock period and a carrier frequency of approximately 97.7 kHz."
    proof: [simulation, analysis]
    modules: []
  - id: S-7
    text: "The PWM duty value shall be 512 + floor(sample_out / 128), with a nominal value of 512 for silence, and shall be updated once per PWM period."
    proof: [simulation, formal]
    modules: []
  - id: S-8
    text: "AUD_PWM shall be open-drain style: it shall be pulled low when the PWM counter is at or above the duty value and otherwise be high-impedance, never actively driven high; each period shall therefore have 1024 minus the duty value low clocks."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: []
  - id: S-9
    text: "AUD_SD shall be held high."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: []
  - id: S-10
    text: "The 16-bit LED output shall be held off."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: []
  - id: S-11
    text: "The top module shall be named c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top and expose AUD_PWM, AUD_SD, CLK100MHZ, CPU_RESETN, the USB-UART pins, LED[15:0], and top-level parameters CLKS_PER_BIT, TIMEOUT_CYCLES, and BUILD_STAMP."
    proof: [analysis, hardware]
    modules: []
  - id: S-12
    text: "The design shall meet timing at a 100 MHz clock."
    proof: [analysis, hardware]
    modules: []
questions:
  - question: "What UART command and response format shall the shell use for sample writes, gain writes, and sample_out reads?"
    default: "Use line-oriented ASCII commands: S followed by a four-digit hexadecimal two's-complement sample, G followed by a four-digit hexadecimal gain, and R to read sample_out as four hexadecimal digits."
    reason: "The required shell operations and baud rate are specified, but the framing, command syntax, numeric encoding, and response format are not."
    settles: [S-5]
  - question: "What are the exact USB-UART top-level port names and directions?"
    default: "Use the Nexys A7 master-XDC names UART_TXD_IN as an input and UART_RXD_OUT as an output."
    reason: "The specification requires the USB-UART pins to use master-XDC names but does not enumerate them."
    settles: [S-11]
  - question: "At what point in the PWM period should a changed duty value take effect?"
    default: "Latch the duty value when the counter wraps from 1023 to 0 and use it for the following period."
    reason: "The specification says duty is updated once per period but does not define the boundary or how mid-period changes are handled."
    settles: [S-7]
  - question: "What reset behavior and phase should the PWM counter have under CPU_RESETN?"
    default: "Reset the counter to zero while CPU_RESETN is asserted so PWM starts at a deterministic phase."
    reason: "The specified reset effects cover the gain and sample but do not state whether reset affects the PWM counter."
    settles: [S-4, S-6]
  - question: "Should CPU_RESETN be treated synchronously or asynchronously to CLK100MHZ?"
    default: "Treat it as an active-low synchronous reset sampled on CLK100MHZ."
    reason: "The reset polarity is given by the port name, but its timing relationship to the clock is not specified."
    settles: [S-4, S-6]

    schema: fpga-design-agent/contract/v1
    module: c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top

    parameters:
      - {name: CLKS_PER_BIT, default: 868}
      - {name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES, default: 100000}

module_specs:
  c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top: |
    This single RTL block is the audio output stage. Its shell register window has
    SAMPLE at 0x00, GAIN at 0x01, and SOUT at 0x02. SAMPLE holds the signed 16-bit
    sample written in bits [15:0]; reads return zero in bits [31:16]. GAIN is
    write-only: writing bits [15:0] sets the gain, capped at 8192, and reads return
    zero. SOUT returns sample_out in bits [15:0] and zero in bits [31:16].
    The gain register resets to 2068. SAMPLE_OUT is the combinational signed result
    floor(sample * gain / 32768).
    The PWM counter is free-running, 10 bits wide, and resets to zero on CPU_RESETN.
    The duty value is 512 + floor(sample_out / 128), latched at counter wrap for the
    following period. AUD_PWM is pulled low at or above the duty value and otherwise
    left high-impedance. AUD_SD is held high and LED is held off.
    The top-level integration also exposes the shell-owned USB-UART pins and forwards
    CLKS_PER_BIT, TIMEOUT_CYCLES, and BUILD_STAMP to the test shell.

  - {id: S-6, text: "The PWM shall use a free-running 10-bit counter clocked by CLK100MHZ, producing a 1024-clock period and a carrier frequency of approximately 97.7 kHz.", proof: [simulation, analysis], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-7, text: "The PWM duty value shall be 512 + floor(sample_out / 128), with a nominal value of 512 for silence, and shall be updated once per PWM period.", proof: [simulation, formal], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}

module_specs:
  c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top: |
    This single RTL block is the audio output stage. Its shell register window has
    SAMPLE at 0x00, GAIN at 0x01, and SOUT at 0x02. SAMPLE holds the signed 16-bit
    sample written in bits [15:0]; reads return zero in bits [31:16]. GAIN is
    write-only: writing bits [15:0] sets the gain, capped at 8192, and reads return
    zero. SOUT returns sample_out in bits [15:0] and zero in bits [31:16].
    The gain register resets to 2068. SAMPLE_OUT is the combinational signed result
    floor(sample * gain / 32768).
    The PWM counter is free-running, 10 bits wide, and resets to zero on CPU_RESETN.
    The duty value is 512 + floor(sample_out / 128), latched at counter wrap for the
    following period. AUD_PWM is pulled low at or above the duty value and otherwise
    left high-impedance. AUD_SD is held high and LED is held off.
    The top-level integration also exposes the shell-owned USB-UART pins and forwards
    CLKS_PER_BIT, TIMEOUT_CYCLES, and BUILD_STAMP to the test shell.

requirements:
  - {id: S-1, text: "The block shall accept a signed 16-bit audio sample that is held between sample writes.", proof: [simulation], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-2, text: "The block shall provide an unsigned Q15 gain register that resets to 2068; a gain write above 8192 shall store 8192, and any other gain write shall store the written value.", proof: [simulation], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-3, text: "The signed 16-bit sample_out shall be combinationally computed as floor(sample * gain / 32768).", proof: [simulation, formal], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-4, text: "When CPU_RESETN is asserted, the sample shall be cleared to zero and the gain register shall be set to 2068.", proof: [simulation], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-5, text: "The UART shell shall run at 115200 baud and shall support writing the sample, writing the gain, and reading sample_out.", proof: [simulation, hardware], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top, top]}
  - {id: S-6, text: "The PWM shall use a free-running 10-bit counter clocked by CLK100MHZ, producing a 1024-clock period and a carrier frequency of approximately 97.7 kHz.", proof: [simulation, analysis], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-7, text: "The PWM duty value shall be 512 + floor(sample_out / 128), with a nominal value of 512 for silence, and shall be updated once per PWM period.", proof: [simulation, formal], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-8, text: "AUD_PWM shall be open-drain style: it shall be pulled low when the PWM counter is at or above the duty value and otherwise be high-impedance, never actively driven high; each period shall therefore have 1024 minus the duty value low clocks.", proof: [simulation, hardware], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-9, text: "AUD_SD shall be held high.", proof: [simulation, hardware], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-10, text: "The 16-bit LED output shall be held off.", proof: [simulation, hardware], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
  - {id: S-11, text: "The top module shall be named c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top and expose AUD_PWM, AUD_SD, CLK100MHZ, CPU_RESETN, the USB-UART pins, LED[15:0], and top-level parameters CLKS_PER_BIT, TIMEOUT_CYCLES, and BUILD_STAMP.", proof: [analysis, hardware], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top, top]}
  - {id: S-12, text: "The design shall meet timing at a 100 MHz clock.", proof: [analysis, hardware], modules: [c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top]}
